many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

demo3={'input':[[7,7,7,7,7,7,8,8,8,8],[7,7,8,8,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,8,8,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7]],'output':[[7,7,2,2,7,7,8,8,8,8],[7,2,8,8,2,7,7,7,7,7],[7,2,8,8,2,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,2,2,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7]]}
pairs=[demo1,demo2,demo3]
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 7 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r,c)]
            seen.add((r,c))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                y,x = stack.pop()
                comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx = y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            top,bottom,left,right=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            height,width=bottom-top+1,right-left+1
            if height != width or height not in (2,3):
                continue
            cells=set(comp)
            solid=len(comp)==height*width
            hollow=all(y in (top,bottom) or x in (left,right) for y,x in comp)
            if not (solid or hollow):
                continue
            if top > 0:
                for x in (left,right): out[top-1][x]=2
            if bottom+1 < h:
                for x in (left,right): out[bottom+1][x]=2
            if left > 0:
                for y in (top,bottom): out[y][left-1]=2
            if right+1 < w:
                for y in (top,bottom): out[y][right+1]=2
    return out
'''
(progdir/f'{task}.py').write_text(code)
ns={};exec(code,ns)

result=ns['transform'](test)
